verdict.rationale: Gmail ships an embedded AI assistant (Gemini), so plugging external MCP servers in as tool sources is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence shows Gmail or Gemini in Gmail can connect to MCP servers. Workspace add-ons, the REST API and push notifications are adjacent extension and developer building blocks, not MCP-client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
